summary.text: Dacia Grayber is a Democratic state representative from District 28 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
She appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic, Working Families Party and Independent Party of Oregon nominations.

paragraphs.text: Dacia Grayber was born in New York, studied at Columbia University and received a bachelor's degree from Concordia University in 2019.
Her career experience includes work as a firefighter and paramedic.
